Luxembourg's minimum wage is 2,704 euros a month. Ukraine's is 173. A thread on legal pay floors in Europe and North America.

a thread 🧵🗺️
1/ Europe, 1 January 2026: Luxembourg 2,704 euros a month, Ireland 2,391, Germany 2,343, the Netherlands 2,295, France 1,823, Spain 1,425, Poland 1,139. Data: Eurostat.

2/ At the bottom: Ukraine 173, Moldova 319, Albania 517, North Macedonia 586, Bulgaria 620. Austria, Denmark, Finland, Italy and Sweden have no national statutory minimum wage, so they are shown without one.

3/ The US federal minimum wage has been $7.25 an hour since 24 July 2009. 20 states, mostly in the South and Midwest, still use it, including Alabama, Georgia, Texas and Pennsylvania. Data: US Dept of Labor, state laws.
4/ At the top: DC at US$18.40 and Washington state at US$17.13. In Canada, provinces set their own rates: Nunavut C$20.17, Yukon C$18.51, BC C$18.25, Ontario C$17.95. US$ for states, C$ for Canada.
Compare with care: euros per month versus dollars per hour, and very different living costs. These maps show legal floors, not what people actually earn. Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
